instruction: Turn on the Slides View panel on the left side of LibreOffice Impress so I can see and switch between slide thumbnails during editing.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the left panel (Slides View) in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator uses the accessibility tree to check if a document-frame named 'Slides View' exists, which indicates the panel is visible. This is similar in complexity to the original task as both involve toggling UI visibility features in LibreOffice Impress.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility tree to detect Slides View panel visibility
Metric function properly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (directly accesses rules dict with expected.get('should_be_visible'))
Logic semantically matches instruction requirement: checking for document-frame named 'Slides View' is the appropriate way to verify the left panel is enabled
Complete coverage: single requirement (enable Slides View panel) is fully verified
Proper error handling with try-except and fail-safe behavior (returns 0.0 on error)
No postconfig needed as panel state persists in accessibility tree after task completion
